scope: Independent exact comparison of durable recovery decisions, physical request artifacts, raw ordered provider output items, and returned actor histories; no hidden reasoning inspection.
limitations: All 86 durable first-wave decisions are verified, including 40 sequential decisions and ten complete branches. The other 400 prospectively assigned research cells remain outside this completed first wave.
No behavioral or efficacy conclusion is inferred from protocol fidelity.
Opaque provider items are compared only as exact retained JSON values/digests; their contents are not interpreted.
